001package com.randomnoun.common.jessop.lang;
002
003import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
004
005import com.randomnoun.common.jessop.AbstractJessopScriptBuilder;
006import com.randomnoun.common.jessop.JessopScriptBuilder;
007
008public class JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder extends AbstractJessopScriptBuilder implements JessopScriptBuilder {
009
010        Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder.class);
011        int outputLine = 1;        // current line number in the target script;
012        int lastScriptletLine = 1; // the last line number of the last scriptlet (used for suppressEol)
013
014        public JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder() {
015        }
016        private void skipToLine(int line) {
017                while (outputLine < line) { print("\n"); }
018        }
019        private void print(String s) {
020                // logger.info("** PRINT " + s);
021                pw.print(s);
022                for (int i=0; i<s.length(); i++) {
023                        if (s.charAt(i)=='\n') { outputLine++; } 
024                }
025        }
026        private static String escapeJavascript(String string) {
027        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(string.length());
028                for (int i = 0; i<string.length(); i++) {
029                        char ch = string.charAt(i);
030                        if (ch=='\n') {
031                            sb.append("\\n");
032                        } else if (ch=='\\' || ch=='"' || ch=='\'' || ch<32 || ch>126) {
033                                String hex = Integer.toString(ch, 16);
034                                sb.append("\\u" + "0000".substring(0, 4-hex.length()) + hex);
035                        } else {
036                                sb.append(ch);
037                        }
038                }
039        return sb.toString();
040    }
041        
042        @Override
043        public void emitText(int line, String s) {
044                skipToLine(line);
045                s = suppressEol(s, declarations.isSuppressEol() && lastScriptletLine == line);
046                print("out.write(\"" + escapeJavascript(s) + "\");");
047                lastScriptletLine = 0; // don't suppress eols on this line
048        }
049        @Override
050        public void emitExpression(int line, String s) {
051                skipToLine(line);
052                print("out.write('' + (" + s + "));"); // coerce to String
053                lastScriptletLine = 0; // don't suppress eols on this line
054        }
055        @Override
056        public void emitScriptlet(int line, String s) {
057                skipToLine(line);
058                print(s);
059                lastScriptletLine = line;
060                for (int i=0; i<s.length(); i++) { if (s.charAt(i)=='\n') { lastScriptletLine++; } }
061        }
062        @Override
063        public String getLanguage() {
064                return "javascript";
065        }
066        @Override
067        public String getDefaultScriptEngineName() {
068                // everything's graal-js these days
069                return "graal-js";
070                
071                /*
072                ScriptEngine engine = new ScriptEngineManager().getEngineByName("graal-js");
073                if (engine!=null) {
074                        return "graal-js";
075                } else {
076                        engine = new ScriptEngineManager().getEngineByName("nashorn");
077                        if (engine!=null) {
078                                return "nashorn";
079                        } else {
080                                return "rhino";
081                        }
082                }
083                */
084        }
085        
086        // this used to return different values depending on which engine was in use
087        @Override
088        public String getDefaultBindingsConverterClassName() {
089                return "com.randomnoun.common.jessop.engine.graaljs.GraalJsBindingsConverter";
090        }
091        
092        @Override
093        public String getDefaultExceptionConverterClassName() {
094                return "com.randomnoun.common.jessop.engine.graaljs.GraalJsExceptionConverter";
095        }
096        
097}
